audit: 2026-09-17 scheduled remote agent, second fire of the day: one 50 question batch across all four modules, published as ten files data/batches/sched_multi_topic_2026-09-17_b_NN.json. Split 20 Psychiatry, 10 Paediatrics, 10 Obstetrics and Gynaecology and 10 Medicine; tier mix 22 L3, 26 L4 and 2 L5 with no L1 and no L2, taking the bank to 6892 with all four modules now level at exactly 1723. Cell selection: the live matrix before this fire read Paediatrics 1713 (L2 422, L3 635, L4 550, L5 88), Obstetrics 1713 (407, 643, 558, 87), Medicine 1713 (380, 658, 572, 87) and Psychiatry 1703 (353, 665, 588, 87). Read literally, with L2 inside the denominator, the deficits against the 50/45/5 ideal are L3 12.93 and L4 12.89 in Paediatrics, 12.46 and 12.43 in Obstetrics, 11.59 and 11.61 in Medicine, 10.95 and 10.47 in Psychiatry, with L5 at a surplus of about 0.1 points everywhere. That reading is degenerate for the sixteenth consecutive fire, because the legacy L2 stock of 1562 questions is roughly 23 per cent of the bank and cannot be reduced by generating: every L3 and L4 cell therefore shows a permanent double digit deficit, the L3 and L4 deficits sit within 0.5 points of each other inside every module so the near tie rule fires on every question, and the raw argmax loads Paediatrics and Obstetrics while starving the two smaller modules. This fire resolved it by computing the same deficits a second way, over the L3 to L5 questions only, on the reasoning that the L2 tier is closed and the achievable shape is the shape of what is being added. Those proportions were Paediatrics 49.88/43.21/6.91, Obstetrics 49.92/43.32/6.75, Psychiatry 49.63/43.88/6.49 and Medicine 49.96/43.43/6.61, giving a clear and non degenerate signal: L3 is already at target within 0.4 points in all four modules, L4 is the deficient tier everywhere at 1.1 to 1.8 points below the 45 per cent ideal, and L5 is in surplus by 1.5 to 1.9 points. The two readings agree that L4 and L3 are the tiers to generate and that L5 is not deficient; they differ only in that the literal reading leaves L3 and L4 tied while the tier restricted reading breaks that tie decisively toward L4. The batch was therefore weighted 26 L4 against 22 L3. L5 was held at 2 rather than the zero a strict deficit reading gives, because on the literal reading L5 sits at 5.08 to 5.14 per cent of module total, that is essentially exactly on the stated 5 per cent target, so replacing at roughly 5 per cent of the batch holds the standing share rather than letting it decay; the 2 were placed in the two modules tied for the lowest live L5 share, Obstetrics and Medicine, both on 5.079 per cent. Module allocation: the Section 2 balance directive requires the four modules to stay within about 10 of each other and to draw from the lowest, and the spread was already at that limit with Psychiatry 10 behind the other three. Allocating 20 to Psychiatry and 10 to each of the others closes the gap exactly and leaves all four on 1723 with a spread of 0, which is a better outcome than the greedy argmax with a spread guard used by the previous fifteen fires, since that approach preserved the skew rather than removing it. Clusters were chosen by measuring live coverage density across candidate subtopics and taking those with zero or near zero prior coverage: Psychiatry took Tourette disorder, antipsychotic hyperprolactinaemia, lithium induced nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, gambling disorder, selective mutism, body dysmorphic disorder, shift work disorder, depersonalisation and derealisation disorder, reactive attachment disorder, prolonged grief disorder, hypnotic deprescribing after a fall, diagnostic overshadowing in intellectual disability, seasonal pattern depression and light therapy, transcranial magnetic stimulation versus electroconvulsive therapy, perinatal obsessive compulsive disorder, tokophobia, foetal alcohol spectrum disorder, long acting injectable antipsychotics, adult attention deficit hyperactivity disorder in women, and the monoamine oxidase inhibitor tyramine reaction; Paediatrics took congenital cytomegalovirus, developmental dysplasia of the hip, eosinophilic oesophagitis, late vitamin K deficiency bleeding, constipation with overflow soiling, cow's milk protein allergy, juvenile idiopathic arthritis uveitis screening, paediatric obstructive sleep apnoea, nutritional rickets, and melatonin for autistic sleep onset delay; Obstetrics took hepatitis B in pregnancy, syphilis in pregnancy with penicillin allergy, preterm prelabour rupture of membranes, polycystic ovary syndrome ovulation induction, emergency contraception at higher body weight, vaginal birth after caesarean induction, levothyroxine in early pregnancy, valproate preconception planning, HELLP, and mechanical valve anticoagulation in pregnancy; Medicine took cauda equina syndrome, alpha one antitrypsin deficiency, normal pressure hydrocephalus, pulmonary arterial hypertension, neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, hypercalcaemia of malignancy, the eosinophilic drug hypersensitivity syndrome, denosumab discontinuation rebound, epidermal necrolysis, and acute intermittent porphyria. Audit: JSON valid, zero em-dashes, zero banned tokens, zero markdown asterisks, zero non ASCII characters, no L1 and no L2, every stem written from the treating doctor's position, answer length ratio at or below 1.35 in all 50 questions with a worst case of 1.25, every source_ref resolving to a label in the question's own sources array, at least two sources per question with an Australian source first, correct answer letters balanced at exactly 10 per letter, tags capped at 3 and drawn from the live vocabulary with guideline names confined to sources, explanation summaries 3 to 5 sentences, key points 3 to 5, pearls carrying named drugs, thresholds and timeframes, and 24 of the 28 L4 and L5 items (85 per cent) built on common presentations against the 50 per cent floor. Australian spelling audit returned seven apparent US forms, all of them the word Fetal inside the official title of the Australian Guide to the Diagnosis of Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorder, retained because a guideline title is a proper noun and the surrounding prose uses foetal. scripts/dupe_gate.py --new passed on the first run with 0 duplicates for all 50 against the 6842 existing questions; the psychiatry block of 20 was additionally gated separately part way through drafting and also passed clean, which caught nothing but cost little and is worth repeating on long batches. Note for the maintainer: the routine prompt's stale header still quotes per module totals near 1378 and a long term target of 500 per module against a bank that is now at 6892, and Section 10 of the context file still forbids Paediatrics and Obstetrics generation from an earlier phase that the current per question cell selection supersedes; both are worth refreshing. The deeper item is the L2 denominator: as long as the 50/45/5 target is read over a denominator that includes 1562 closed L2 questions, the deficit signal will stay degenerate no matter how the ties are broken. Either state the target over the L3 to L5 tiers explicitly, or retire the L2 stock, and the argmax becomes well behaved on its own.
